title: DataEntity
description: TOGAF-sourced archetype — Data Entity classification vocabulary. Defines governance-relevant properties for data entities: category, format, lifecycle stage, system of record. Rootless, domain-scoped — applies only to data entities, not transversal to all governed things. A Data Entity is not a Structure (Structures are constituted of Mechanisms). Each concrete data entity is defined by its own Archetype schema; this schema provides the classification vocabulary for governance over those definitions. Source framework: TOGAF (Data Architecture, Content Metamodel).

dataCategory.description: Data entity classification. REFERENCE = lookup/static data (countries, currencies). MASTER = core business entities (customer, product). TRANSACTIONAL = event-driven records (orders, payments). ANALYTICAL = derived/aggregated data (reports, metrics). METADATA = data about data (schemas, lineage). TOGAF mapping: Data Entity categorization in Data Architecture. Norm example: DataEntity.dataCategory == 'MASTER'.

dataFormat.description: Primary data format. STRUCTURED = relational/tabular. SEMI_STRUCTURED = JSON/XML/Avro. UNSTRUCTURED = documents/images/video. Drives storage strategy and integration pattern selection.

lifecycleStage.description: Current lifecycle stage. Norm example: DataEntity.lifecycleStage != 'PENDING_DELETION'. Drives retention policy enforcement and storage tier selection.

sourceSystem.description: System of record for this data entity (e.g., 'crm', 'erp', 'data-lake'). Enables data lineage governance and ownership mapping.
